This forgery suggests a deliberate attempt to deceive users or analysts into trusting the file as legitimate software. The use of VB6 runtime (MSVBVM60.DLL) points to a Visual Basic 6 dropper, a common vehicle for malware distribution due to its lightweight nature and ability to embed payloads. This lineage aligns with known malware families that use packing and spoofing for initial access.
